description: Given a local assignment \(g_F\) on each finite subset \(F\) of an arbitrary index set, with finitely many available values at each index, there is a global assignment \(f\) such that for each finite \(J\) some finite \(F\) containing \(J\) satisfies \(f\mathbin{\upharpoonright}J=g_F\mathbin{\upharpoonright}J\).
